source_inspections.note: White House Live headline: Vice President JD Vance Holds Press Conference on Fighting Visa Fraud; page inspected as event metadata, not a transcript or complete recording.
Reuters lines 177-189: eight firms named; no new or pending PERM applications accepted or processed; nine universities investigated; subpoenas served; alleged fraud and research-security rationale.
AP lines 1832 onward: Microsoft suspension, PERM process, J-1 and outsourcing allegations, nine named universities, administration rationale and lack of immediate institutional responses.
White House fact-sheet lines 149-182: mixed $6B headline, $2.4B industry credits, regional compute, instruments, fellowships, NASA-DOE MOU, quantum and research-organization programs.
Washington Post lines 24-61: compute, consortium and fellowship announcements; prior research cuts and withholding; administration merit and high-impact-science responses.
Axios lines 45-58: more than $1B industry commitments, Southeast compute hub, Georgia investment, $100M instruments, Genesis context.
OGE 278-T pages 2, 10, 12, 15 and 16: four Nvidia purchases and one sale with dates and value ranges; signed September 17 and received September 25.
Reuters lines 151-175: Nvidia trade totals, chip-policy context, science medal timing and White House independent-manager/index-replication response.
